text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo is having some trouble during practice…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Why was it… so hard to breathe… midway through…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Such a feeble stride is unbecoming a king…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes… I'm fine. It's… not a problem.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: A first-rate runner does not fall apart from such trivial loads. There must be something else wrong…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll show you what a truly powerful stride looks like!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, even after saying that, King Halo still can't find her usual vigor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The repeated races may be taking a toll on her. I think we need to make some changes to her schedule…
